verses.translation: A Psalm of David. To thee, O Lord, have I cried; my God, be not silent toward me: lest thou be silent toward me, and so I should be likened to them that go down to the pit.

translations.ron: Către Tine, Doamne, am strigat, Dumnezeul meu, ia aminte! Că de nu mă vei auzi, mă voi asemăna cu cei care se coboară în groapă.

verses.translation: Hearken to the voice of my supplication, when I pray to thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy temple.

translations.ron: Ascultă glasul rugăciunii mele când mă rog către Tine, când ridic mâinile mele către locaşul Tău cel sfânt.

verses.translation: Draw not away my soul with sinners, and destroy me not with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace with their neighbours, but evils are in their hearts.

translations.ron: Să nu tragi cu cei păcătoşi sufletul meu, şi cu cei ce lucrează nedreptate să nu mă pierzi,

verses.translation: Give them according to their works, and according to the wickedness of their devices: give them according to the works of their hands; render their recompence unto them.

translations.ron: Cu cei ce grăiesc pace către aproapele lor, dar cele rele sunt în inimile lor.

verses.translation: Because they have not attended to the works of the Lord, even to the works of his hands, thou shalt pull them down, and shalt not build them up.

translations.ron: Dă-le lor după faptele lor şi după vicleşugul gândurilor lor.

verses.translation: Blessed be the Lord, for he has hearkened to the voice of my petition.

translations.ron: După lucrul mâinilor lor, dă-le lor; răsplăteşte-i după faptele lor,

verses.translation: The Lord is my helper and my defender; my heart has hoped in him, and I am helped: my flesh has revived, and willingly will I give praise to him.

translations.ron: Că n-au înţeles lucrurile Domnului şi faptele mâinilor Lui; îi vei dărâma şi nu-i vei zidi.

verses.translation: The Lord is the strength of his people, and the saving defender of his anointed.

translations.ron: Binecuvântat este Domnul că a auzit glasul rugăciunii mele.

verses.translation: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: and take care of them, and lift them up for ever.

translations.ron: Domnul este ajutorul şi apărătorul meu, în El a nădăjduit inima mea şi mi-a ajutat.
